name: Rutherford Recreation Day Camp
description_short: Six week borough day camp for Rutherford resident children entering kindergarten through grade 8, with sports, arts and crafts, special events, themed days and optional field trips. Families register for all six weeks.
notes: Resident children only. All six weeks must be booked; no camp July 3. Two camp t-shirts included. Field trips are booked separately after registration closes. No makeup days, refunds or credits for weather or absences; tuition is paid in full before camp. Registration opened April 1, 2026 on RecDesk. The post gives no fee or camp site.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Borough's own post for the 2026 camp (the Recreation page links only this post). Ages derived from grades K to 8. ZIP is the borough hall address in the page header (176 Park Ave, Rutherford, NJ 07070)
